item: Redundant `!` and `HasValue` (newer-rules survey #5, #6; Sonar S8969, Meziantou MA0171)
notes: BRO1147 (a null-forgiving `!` on a value already not null; skips multi-targeted projects, type arguments, `null!`) and BRO1148 (`x.HasValue` -> `x is not null`, in BRO1133's form), both off by default (decisions.md). The SDK's IDE0370 works too once its severity is set (rule page).
